ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. (NASDAQ ADR)
ideas.thesis: SKHY appeared in all 6 overnight screens — the strongest consensus signal of the session. The stock carries a ~40% gap to the 14-analyst consensus price target of $247.31 vs. last close ~$177, supported by Q2 revenue growth of +51% QoQ, HBM capacity sold out through 2027, and a freshly signed $4B Indiana HBM production hub MOU with Purdue (Aug 27). Bernstein reaffirmed Buy on September 4, and the stock has pulled back ~$30 from recent highs, creating a re-entry zone ahead of Q3 earnings in October.
ideas.catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings (est. October); $4B Indiana HBM MOU signed Aug 27; Bernstein Buy reaffirm Sept 4; FOMC Sept 16 as rate-sensitive growth name
ideas.edge: 14-analyst consensus PT $247.31 vs ~$177 last close = ~39.7% upside gap; Q2 revenue +51% QoQ; HBM supply locked into Nvidia's AI infrastructure roadmap; IPO'd July 2026 still at discount to Morningstar fair value
ideas.bull_case: HBM demand locked into Nvidia's AI infrastructure cycle with capacity sold out through 2027, a $4B US anchor investment de-risking geopolitical concerns, and institutional reaffirmations creating a path toward the $247 consensus target.
ideas.bear_case: High-beta ADR is exposed to a Fed hike surprise on Sept 16 and any macro risk-off rotation; as a recently listed ADR it lacks a long trading history, and memory cycles can turn faster than analyst targets adjust.
